WIFI_SET.description: 0x14 request on config. Since 0.10.0: add/update, or forget saved Wi-Fi networks (boards with the wifi feature).

ssid.description: Network name; required unless forgetting all saved networks.; str: max 32 UTF-8 bytes; min 1 bytes

password.description: Empty or absent = open network, else 8-63 bytes (WPA2/WPA3 passphrase). Write-only.; str: max 63 UTF-8 bytes

forget.description: True without ssid: erase all saved networks. True with ssid: erase that network; password is ignored.

status.description: status code: 0 OK, 1 UNKNOWN_MESSAGE, 2 MALFORMED, 3 UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, 4 MISSING_FIELD, 5 TOO_LARGE, 6 INVALID_UTF8, 7 INVALID_ID, 8 OUT_OF_RANGE, 9 UNKNOWN_KEY, 10 TYPE_MISMATCH, 11 READ_ONLY, 12 REVISION_CONFLICT, 13 INSUFFICIENT_SECURITY, 14 BUSY, 15 NO_SPACE, 16 BAD_OFFSET, 17 NO_SESSION, 18 CRC_MISMATCH, 19 HASH_MISMATCH, 20 SIGNATURE_INVALID, 21 IMAGE_INVALID, 22 LOW_BATTERY, 23 VERSION_REJECTED, 24 NOT_FOUND, 25 UNSUPPORTED, 26 SEGMENT_ERROR, 27 INTERNAL

CONFIG_CHANGED.description: 0x60 event on config. Config or app policies changed.

config_values.description: Typed view of config values by key name (registry config_keys).

ui.language.description: key 1 (0x0001), since 0.1.0. On-device UI language. enum language (unknown values -> 0): 0 en, 1 vi

display.orientation.description: key 2 (0x0002), since 0.1.0. Rotation in 90 degree steps.

display.full_refresh_every.description: key 3 (0x0003), since 0.1.0, variants ['paper']. E-paper: full refresh after this many partial refreshes (a clock redraw counts as one, anything else as a quarter; a full refresh that falls due waits for a quiet moment). Default 10 before 0.9.2.

display.show_body.description: key 4 (0x0004), since 0.1.0. Show message body (false = title only, for privacy).

ui.clock_24h.description: key 5 (0x0005), since 0.6.0. Clock format: true = 24-hour, false = 12-hour with AM/PM.

ui.temp_unit.description: key 6 (0x0006), since 0.6.0. Unit of the temperature shown on boards with the climate feature. enum temp_unit (unknown values -> 0): 0 celsius, 1 fahrenheit

display.brightness.description: key 7 (0x0007), since 0.8.0, variants ['lcd']. Backlight brightness in percent while active (0 = off).

display.idle_dim_s.description: key 8 (0x0008), since 0.8.0, variants ['lcd']. Dim the backlight after this many seconds without activity; 0 = never.

display.idle_off_s.description: key 9 (0x0009), since 0.8.0, variants ['lcd']. Switch the backlight and the panel off after this many seconds without activity; 0 = never. Default 300 before 0.12.1.

display.mask_numbers.description: key 10 (0x000A), since 0.10.1. Privacy: show every number of 4 or more digits as **** on the cards (one-time codes, balances); digits may be joined by . or , (1.234 and 1,234,567 are one number).

notif.default_app_policy.description: key 16 (0x0010), since 0.1.0. Policy for apps without an explicit allow/block. enum default_policy (unknown values -> 0): 0 allow, 1 block

notif.category_mask.description: key 17 (0x0011), since 0.1.0. Bit per category; cleared bits are hidden. bitmask category_mask: bit 0 other, bit 1 incoming_call, bit 2 missed_call, bit 3 voicemail, bit 4 social, bit 5 schedule, bit 6 email, bit 7 news, bit 8 health_and_fitness, bit 9 business_and_finance, bit 10 location, bit 11 entertainment

notif.min_priority.description: key 18 (0x0012), since 0.1.0. Hide notifications below this priority. enum priority (unknown values -> 1): 0 low, 1 normal, 2 high, 3 urgent

notif.show_silent.description: key 19 (0x0013), since 0.1.0. Show notifications flagged silent.

quiet.start_min.description: key 33 (0x0021), since 0.1.0. Quiet hours start, minutes after local midnight.

quiet.end_min.description: key 34 (0x0022), since 0.1.0. Quiet hours end, minutes after local midnight (may be before start: spans midnight).

time.tz_offset_min.description: key 48 (0x0030), since 0.1.0. Local time offset from UTC in minutes.

ui.theme_id.description: key 64 (0x0040), since 0.1.0. Installed theme asset id; empty = built-in. str: max 32 UTF-8 bytes

ui.font_id.description: key 65 (0x0041), since 0.1.0. Installed font asset id; empty = built-in. str: max 32 UTF-8 bytes

ui.background_id.description: key 66 (0x0042), since 0.7.0. Installed background asset id; empty = none. Takes precedence over a theme's background. str: max 32 UTF-8 bytes

ui.clock_face_id.description: key 67 (0x0043), since 0.15.0. Installed clock_face asset id (or a built-in face's id) shown on the clock screen; empty = the built-in Classic face. An id that is not installed shows Classic. str: max 32 UTF-8 bytes

ui.clock_face_opts.description: key 68 (0x0044), since 0.15.0. The active face's option values: pairs of bytes (option id, value). Unknown ids are ignored and a value out of range uses the option's default. Lower-case hex in logical form. hex-encoded bytes

weather.enabled.description: key 80 (0x0050), since 0.9.0, variants ['lcd', 'paper']. Fetch the weather over Wi-Fi and show it on the idle screen.

weather.city.description: key 81 (0x0051), since 0.9.0, variants ['lcd', 'paper']. Place name the board looks up for the weather; empty = locate by the network's IP address. str: max 64 UTF-8 bytes

weather.interval_min.description: key 82 (0x0052), since 0.9.0, variants ['lcd', 'paper']. Minutes between weather fetches (each one joins Wi-Fi and runs a TLS handshake). Default 30 before 0.12.1.

update.auto_check.description: key 83 (0x0053), since 0.14.0, variants ['lcd', 'paper']. Check for a new firmware release once a day over Wi-Fi and offer it on the board; off = only when the user asks.
